entities.name: Ali-Naqi Vaziri
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ali-Naqi Vaziri, also transcribed as Ali Naghi Vaziri, was a composer, thinker, and celebrated player of the tar. He is considered a revolutionary icon in the history of 20th-century Persian music.
